note: Every image the vision-slice work needs. Generate each entry as its own file into art_inbox/ using the given filename; tools/compose_icon_sheet.py then tiles the icons into assets/RandomIcon04.png (5 x 5, same layout as the existing store sheets). Art contains no words (localization): item names come from the game. Asteroid ore atlases (asteroid_ore_*) are not icons: attach assets/asteroidTextures.png as the style reference instead, and save each straight to its destination. Prop sheets (props_*) are whole 5 x 5 sheets in one image, with a written style brief and no reference image: the older icon sheets were made from another game's art (Abe), so they are never attached as references.
shared_style: Square game inventory icon. A single sci-fi object, three-quarter view, centred, on a very dark navy background (#0b1016) inside a thin light-grey rounded square frame with a small margin. Realistic brushed and scuffed metal with small glowing accents, dramatic rim light, soft glow. No text, no letters, no labels, no numbers anywhere in the image (the game adds names itself, so art stays language-neutral). No watermark, no border outside the frame. Painterly-realistic like a premium space-game item shop.

images.used_for: Store and inventory icon for survey_drone (Piloted Survey Drone), the consumable the captain flies into asteroid cracks and wrecks.
images.prompt: A small, expensive piloted mining drone: a compact rounded hull the size of a briefcase, one bright forward camera lens and a headlight, two slim folded manipulator arms with a fine cutting tool, tiny thrusters glowing pale teal. Precision instrument, not a weapon.

images.used_for: Icon for thermal_lattice, a tech-grade material: heat-shedding crystal lattice that engine, power plant and weapon parts are made from.
images.prompt: A raw chunk of rare mineral: a dense geometric lattice of translucent amber-orange crystal, glowing hot from inside like embers, fine heat shimmer, dark stone matrix at its base. Precious, fragile, clearly valuable.

images.used_for: Icon for rad_quartz, a tech-grade material: radiation-hardening quartz for shields, sensors and mining optics.
images.prompt: A cluster of long hexagonal quartz crystals in a luminous acid green, faint inner glow, tiny particle motes around it, set on dark rock. Looks rare and slightly dangerous.

images.used_for: Icon for cryo_ferrite, a tech-grade material that holds its shape from deep cold to full sun; hulls, holds and storage bays are built from it.
images.prompt: A dark metallic ferrite ore nugget with an ice-blue frosted crust and pale blue veins, faint frost vapour curling off it, metallic sheen underneath the frost.

images.used_for: Icon for resonant_crystal, the rarest material: grown only in the deepest, most fragile seams; top-tier ship upgrades need it.
images.prompt: A single flawless crystal spire, iridescent white shifting to violet and cyan, visible faint concentric ripple rings in the air around it as if it hums, delicate and extremely precious.

images.used_for: Optional overlay for the first-person drone camera (DroneMazeView): a camera-feed frame drawn over the 3D view.
images.prompt: A transparent-background HUD overlay for a mining drone's camera feed: thin teal corner brackets, a faint scanline texture, tiny tick marks along the edges, a small blinking red dot in the top right. The whole centre must be fully transparent. PNG with alpha. This one does NOT use the shared icon style.

images.used_for: Rock texture atlas for asteroids carrying water ice (same 3 x 3 layout as assets/asteroidTextures.png; each rock uses one square).
images.prompt: A 3 x 3 grid of nine different seamless close-up rock surface textures for asteroids, exactly the layout, framing and photographic realism of the attached reference sheet (thin light lines between the nine squares, every square filled edge to edge, viewed straight on, soft even light, no perspective). Same dark space-rock base as the reference; vary the nine squares the same way (fractured slabs, fine gravel, layered shale, pitted pumice, cracked plates, rubble). Water-ice rock: the dark stone is crusted with pale blue-white frost and glassy ice in the cracks and hollows, a little translucent ice showing through, cold and muted, still mostly rock. No text, no letters, no labels, no watermark.

Each object in three-quarter view, centred, realistic painted rendering: worn metal, plastic and glass with small coloured status lights, soft rim light, gentle glow. Grounded, practical, lived-in industrial space-frontier equipment, original designs. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, labels, logos or symbols anywhere, not even on the objects. Row 1, left to right: compressed o2 canister; co2 scrubber cartridge; water purification unit; hydrogen fuel canister; fuel block. Row 2, left to right: medical supply crate; vaccine cooler; ration crate; hydroponic seed vault; filter pack. Row 3, left to right: radiation suit; reactor coolant drum; portable generator; airlock seal kit; thermal blanket bundle. Row 4, left to right: emergency beacon; life-support control board; solar panel patch; mining charge; drill head. Row 5, left to right: ore sample case; ice core tube; atmosphere sensor; portable stasis pod; worn duffel bag.
